verdict.rationale: CrewAI docs confirm agents can be defined with role/goal and can use tools (crewai-docs-6, crewai-docs-33, crewai-docs-52), and community usage (crewai-comm-1) shows tool-calling agents built with CrewAI. However, the evidence never shows a concrete code snippet for defining a *custom* tool with typed inputs (e.g., Pydantic schema) in a few lines, so the 'typed' and 'few lines' aspects are only inferred, not demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit custom-tool code example with type annotations/schema, independent hands-on confirmation of ease of typed tool creation.
